programme.desc: Presenter Fresia Cousiño Arias receives three young football followers in the setting of Voetbalpraat. programme.desc: A three-part documentary series dedicated to Thailand. programme.title: Wild Thailand – The center of the country | E02
programme.desc: A three-part documentary series dedicated to Thailand. Although this country is mainly associated with beautiful beaches, what impresses the most is the wild nature and the diversity of animals found there, which often amaze people who come there. Life in Thailand changes very quickly. People and animals are looking for new ways to coexist peacefully. Great Britain. 2017. nature film

programme.title: Wild Thailand – Mysterious North | E03
programme.desc: A three-part documentary series dedicated to Thailand. Although this country is mainly associated with beautiful beaches, what impresses the most is the wild nature and the diversity of animals found there, which often amaze people who come there. Phu Khieo, i.e. the northern areas of Thailand, is a wild land inaccessible to humans. The landscape here is diverse. Almost two thirds of the area is covered by mountains covered with forests. There are many rare animal species here, such as the Indochinese leopard, Malayan tapir, binturong, as well as numerous species of primates. In a land isolated by the mountains, there are also archaic communities whose members form surprising alliances with nature. The highest peak in the region - Doi Inthanon, is called the roof of Thailand. It rises over two and a half thousand meters above sea level. In the north-eastern areas of Thailand, where there was previously a forest, there are now farmlands. However, for residents, the bond with nature is still extremely important. The mountains of northern Thailand constitute the largest protected area in this part of Asia. The Huai Kha Khaeng Reserve is home to extremely rare animal species, including: Burmese bantengs. Great Britain. 2017. nature film

programme.title: 30 for 30: Phi Slama Jama
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/f Cheetah. From hunter to prey
programme.desc: This program takes us into the world of wildlife, where cheetahs are constantly fighting for survival. We will see their life path from cubs to adults, reveal the peculiarities of daytime hunting and learn how much strength speed takes away, as a result of which other predators often take away the cheetah’s prey. The survival of the fastest beast on Earth involves overcoming many difficulties, and this struggle cannot but inspire admiration. The cheetah is a perfect creature, the fastest land animal among mammals. Of all the representatives of the cat family, this animal is one of the most adapted to life in its habitat, the African savannah. Thanks to its impeccable aerodynamic body structure with an incredibly flexible back, powerful muscles and long legs, the cheetah reaches speeds of over one hundred kilometers per hour in a few seconds! A rather massive tail allows it to change direction with lightning speed in pursuit of ungulates running in zigzags, and an intensely working heart and lungs make it possible to run at top speeds. Spain, 2016

programme.title: Cantabria – Spain’s magic mountains
programme.desc: Wolves on the hunt, bears in a clinch and snow up to animal mustaches: In the harsh Cantabrian mountains, animals fight for survival - through four seasons full of dangers. (Station info).

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: Tourists appreciate the beaches, the weather and the culture of life. But there is more to discover in the Caribbean island world. Between the Bahamas, Grand Cayman and Costa Rica, “Terra X” accompanies researchers as they dive into cave systems, breed rare blue iguanas and observe clever white-shouldered capuchins.

programme.title: Expedition Europa
programme.desc: The landscape appears pristine, and the Scottish Highlands (above) are actually one of the geologically oldest regions on the continent. This is where Colin Devey begins his journey through three billion (!) years of Earth's history. The stages include the German low mountain ranges, the Azores and the seven Manpupunjor rocks in the Urals.

programme.title: Expedition Europa
programme.desc: The peregrine falcon circles elegantly over the Elbe Sandstone Mountains (above). In terms of geological history, this natural landscape is still relatively young. The striking rock formations were formed by the Elbe, which worked its way through the sedimentary rocks deposited by a primeval ocean. The Alps, on the other hand, were formed through a different geological process. High peaks such as the Matterhorn and Zugspitze were folded as a result of the collision of the African and European tectonic plates. Colin Devey also visits Vesuvius in Italy. The ruins of Pompeii bear witness to the destructive forces that lie deep underground.

programme.title: Our Mediterranean
programme.desc: From the French Riviera to the Greek islands: a loggerhead sea turtle travels huge distances to reproduce. Likewise white storks and bluefin tuna. (Station info).

programme.title: Seals' Playground - The Wild Coast of Brittany
programme.desc: Seals and gray seals live in harsh conditions on the coast of Brittany. Strong tides, predators and territorial battles characterize their everyday lives - especially during mating season. (Station info).

programme.title: Our Mediterranean
programme.desc: How can monk seals, fin whales and lesser falcons give birth and raise their young in peace? People and mass tourism are increasingly endangering their reproduction. (Station info).

programme.title: Our Mediterranean
programme.desc: As male flamingos or dolphin leaders grow older, it affects the entire social structure. But some species seem to live forever, like the olive trees on the Mediterranean. (Station info).

programme.title: Our Mediterranean
programme.desc: Turtles, bluefin tuna, seagrass beds: they are all threatened with extinction. Scientists around the world are working on solutions to preserve species. (Station info).

programme.title: Our Mediterranean
programme.desc: Breathtaking images of a free diver at a depth of 50 meters are created under difficult conditions. With a lot of patience, the cameramen track down monk seals in underwater caves. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's natural wonders - a day like no other
programme.desc: A day full of extremes in Africa: snowfall on Mount Kenya, lion hunting in Kruger Park and a fighting ostrich father. Africa's nature shows itself in its wildest and most beautiful form. (Station info).

programme.title: The time of the big cats
programme.desc: Since the Ice Age, the saber-toothed cat has been the benchmark of all carnivores. The animals could weigh more than 300 kilograms and had canine teeth that were 20 centimeters long. Their heyday lasted until around 12,000 years ago at the turn of the Pleistocene to the Holocene, when the prey pattern became fatal for the biters. Lions, more agile snow leopards and cheetahs - they already belong to the subspecies of small cats - as well as jaguars adapted more flexibly to changing environmental conditions. 3 episodes.

programme.title: The time of the big cats
programme.desc: Lions became the new top predators thanks to their sophisticated hunting strategies. Living in large packs also helped them to assert themselves against competitors. (Station info).

programme.title: The time of the big cats
programme.desc: Pumas and leopards once had to assert themselves against powerful rivals. Your weapons? Camouflage, deception and adaptation. These strategies ensured their survival to this day. (Station info).

programme.title: Secret Safari: Into the Wild
programme.desc: A young cheetah fights for survival. A Hartebeest defends its herd. Rangers help cocktail ants in the Ol Pejeta Sanctuary against dangerous intruders. (Station info).

programme.title: Secret Safari: Into the Wild
programme.desc: Impala Jaribou defends his territory against rivals while impressing a harem of 50 females. Meanwhile, rangers fight for the life of the injured female rhino Imara. (Station info).

programme.title: Fascination with otters
programme.desc: Playful, adaptable and excellent swimmers: otters have fascinated photographer Charlie Hamilton James for 25 years. With amazing experiments he uncovers their survival strategies. (Station info).

programme.title: Boss Shark: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: A competition of giants: experts test whether male or female great white sharks are the true rulers of the ocean in spectacular jumping and strength challenges. (Station info).

programme.title: Our farm with Cheyenne and Nino – new stable stories
programme.desc: Special of the Sky Original reality documentary: Cheyenne and Nino show their family life with two small children and reveal their future plans for the Chianina farm. (Station info).

programme.title: Our wild favorites
programme.desc: Even the lap dog or cuddly tomcat still has the wild animal in it, and it wants to come out when playing. Funny shots, some from an animal perspective.

programme.title: Crazy but true!
programme.desc: Some animal encounters send shivers down your spine: an elephant attack becomes a race with death. Elsewhere, a sea lion “kidnaps” a little girl. (Station info).

programme.title: Crazy but true!
programme.desc: There are plenty of dangerous situations in the animal kingdom - a bear is looking for food outside its territory, a rat encounters a hungry cat. Conflicts often end differently than expected. (Station info).

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Stars am Limit
programme.desc: In this documentary soap, survival artist Bear Grylls teams up with a celebrity for 48 hours and tests his will to survive. In a remote location, the stars have to learn how to get by far away from comfort and the internet. Bear Grylls shows them how to take care of themselves and protect themselves from the cruelties of nature. The challenge is faced by, among others: Zac Efron, Ben Stiller, Channing Tatum and Mel B.

programme.title: Pangolins – hunted and sought after

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S15 EP229
programme.desc: Trong thế kỷ 21, UFO đã đi từ khoa học ngoài lề trở thành nỗi ám ảnh chính thống. Một thế hệ thợ săn UFO mới đang sử dụng công nghệ và UFO đang được chính phủ điều tra công khai.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST ESCAPES WITH MORGAN FREEMAN S2 EP16
programme.desc: Rene Belbenoit, một tên trộm vặt, bị bắt và đưa đến thuộc địa hình sự khét tiếng của Pháp ở Guiana thuộc Pháp. Anh quyết tâm trốn thoát hoặc cố gắng chết. Câu chuyện của anh trở thành nền tảng của một số bộ phim nổi tiếng.

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP26
programme.desc: Điều gì có thể nằm ngoài giới hạn của Dải Ngân hà? Có thiên hà tương tự như của chúng ta không? Họ có thể có khả năng duy trì cuộc sống thông minh? Và cuộc sống đó có cố gắng liên lạc với chúng ta không?

programme.title: HAZARDOUS HISTORY WITH HENRY WINKLER S1 EP01
programme.desc: Bạn có nhớ khi thời thơ ấu đi kèm với một bên nguy hiểm không? Hãy suy nghĩ lại các đồ chơi thái quá và những trò hề sân chơi táo bạo mà từng được xác định lớn lên, khi chúng ta khám phá bộ dụng cụ khoa học bùng nổ và hơn thế nữa.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S11 EP23
programme.desc: Trong khi nhóm phát hiện ra một phát hiện đáng ngạc nhiên ở Lô 5, các thành viên của Hiệp hội đến Châu Âu và ngay lập tức khám phá thêm nhiều mối liên hệ với Hiệp sĩ dòng Đền.

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S15 EP218
programme.desc: Các nghiên cứu đã chỉ ra rằng có tới 70% tất cả các lần nhìn thấy UFO xảy ra trong cái gọi là 'điểm nóng' trong đó các báo cáo về tầm nhìn và hiện tượng bất thường được chứng kiến, và không chỉ trong thời hiện đại, mà hàng ngàn năm trước.

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP33
programme.desc: Trong suốt lịch sử, nhiều người đã tuyên bố có thể nhìn thấy tương lai và thay đổi tiến trình lịch sử. Nhưng những lời tiên tri của họ đã tiết lộ điều gì? Và họ đã đưa ra những dự đoán gì cho tương lai?

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S5 EP01
programme.desc: Năm 1698, thuyền trưởng Kidd đột kích một con tàu trên biển và chiếm đoạt kho báu của nó... nhưng Kidd bị treo cổ trước khi tiết lộ nơi ông giấu nó. Chuyện gì đã xảy ra với chiến lợi phẩm bị thất lạc của thuyền trưởng Kidd... và giờ nó ở đâu?

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S2 EP19
programme.desc: Từ việc coi Sân vận động Cựu chiến binh là nhà cho đến dựng trại ở nhà ga sân bay cho đến biến thùng rác thành nơi ở sang trọng. Mỗi ngôi nhà này đều kỳ lạ đến mức chúng thực sự khó tin.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S2 EP20

programme.title: THE MEGA-BRANDS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S3 EP15
programme.desc: Để đơn giản hóa các công việc văn phòng tẻ nhạt vào giữa thế kỷ 20, một công ty vô danh đã giới thiệu máy photocopy đầu tiên trên thế giới và trở thành một cái tên quen thuộc, khơi mào cho cuộc cạnh tranh giữa hai thương hiệu mang tính biểu tượng.
